name: clause_checklist
description: Clause checklist for a contract type (NDA, services, lease, employment, sale of goods, software licence, GDPR Article 28 data processing agreement): each clause's purpose and the questions to ask, with the legal reference for the DPA's mandatory contents. Given a contract text in English or Spanish, it reports each clause as found, with the matching snippet, or missing, by keyword and heading heuristics. Heuristic and not legal advice.

input.text: This Agreement is made between Acme Ltd and Beta SL. Confidential Information means any information disclosed by one party. This Agreement is governed by the laws of England and Wales.

catalog.source: original; DPA contents from Regulation (EU) 2016/679 (GDPR) Art. 28(2)-(4), 32-36 and Chapter V; CISG Art. 6 for the sale-of-goods note
